question: Is 'Aatrox declares no cast dependencies' the correct value, i.e. does any cast in Aatrox's rotation have a prerequisite (another cast, a form, a stack, a charge, a resource, or a buff) that a resolver would have to satisfy before the cast can occur?

step_1_enumerate_kit_from_cached_wiki.P Deathbringer Stance: Innate on a level-scaled timer (22.0 s at level 1 -> 10.0 s at level 18, affectedByCdr:false). Empowers the NEXT basic attack; it is not an activated cast. Cooldown is *accelerated* by hits (2 s per ability/AA hit on a champion or large monster, 4 s on a Q Sweetspot) - a timer modifier, never a gate on any cast.
step_1_enumerate_kit_from_cached_wiki.Q The Darkin Blade: Three activations of ONE ability before it goes on cooldown; 1 s static cooldown between activations, 4 s recast window (binary DataValue QExtensionTime = 4.0). Damage ramps +25% per subsequent activation (QRampBonus = 0.25). Ability cooldown 14/12/10/8/6, affectedByCdr:true.
step_1_enumerate_kit_from_cached_wiki.W Infernal Chains: Single activation; the second damage instance is the tether resolving 1.5 s later - internal to the same activation, gated by the target not breaking the tether, not by another cast. Cooldown 20/18/16/14/12.
step_1_enumerate_kit_from_cached_wiki.E Umbral Dash: Single activation, cooldown 9/8/7/6/5; wiki: 'can be cast during his other abilities without cancelling them and vice versa' - explicitly the LEAST constrained cast in the kit.
step_1_enumerate_kit_from_cached_wiki.R World Ender: Single activation, cooldown 120/100/80. Grants bonus AD (20/30/40% total AD) and increased healing (50/75/100%) for 10 s. It buffs later casts; it does not gate them.
step_1_enumerate_kit_from_cached_wiki.conclusion: No form, no stacks, no charges, no resource cost (all four abilities have cost: null in the cache), no ally/enemy-state gate. The only ordering structure in the kit is INTERNAL to a single ability: Q's 3-activation chain and W's tether follow-up.

step_2_is_the_Q_chain_a_rotation_level_d.concern: If the engine's rotation enumerated Q's three activations as three separate casts, then activation 2 would depend on activation 1 and activation 3 on activation 2 (game binary tags AatroxQ 'Trait_RecastOrReplaceSpell'; AatroxQAbility.mChildSpells = [AatroxQ, AatroxQ2, AatroxQ3, AatroxQWrapperCast]), and two of the seven ledgers could not be empty.
step_2_is_the_Q_chain_a_rotation_level_d.test: Reconstruct the corpus scenario e9-e1-aatrox-umbral-dash-heal (Aatrox 18, no items, Q5/W5/E5/R3, one_rotation, enemy Ahri 18) from raw data and check whether the engine's per-cast damage events are per-activation or per-ability.

step_2_is_the_Q_chain_a_rotation_level_d.finding: The corpus records exactly TWO ability damage events for a full Aatrox rotation - one Q event carrying the sum of all three activations, one W event carrying both tether hits. The engine's cast granularity is therefore one cast per ABILITY ACTIVATION SEQUENCE, not per recast. Q's chain and W's tether are resolved inside a single cast (math-foundations calls this the cast's parts: '_evaluate_cast_parts'), so neither is visible as an inter-cast edge in the rotation.

step_3_what_gates_a_cast_in_this_engine.quoted_model: math-foundations 1.1: 'each cast occupies its sourced cast time, an ability recasts when its effective cooldown has elapsed *and* no other cast is in progress, and a cast counts when it starts within the window (_schedule_shared_casts)'.
step_3_what_gates_a_cast_in_this_engine.reading: The only admission conditions in the scheduling model are (a) the ability's own effective cooldown and (b) mutual exclusion on the shared timeline. Neither is a declared per-cast dependency; both are properties the scheduler already owns. A dependency ledger therefore records champion-specific prerequisites - the stack/charge/form mechanics CLAUDE.md lists as needing per-champion options (Gnar Rage/Mega, Aurelion Sol Stardust, Vladimir E charge, Yasuo/Yone Q3, K'Sante W, Bard chimes, Zeri P). Aatrox has none of them.
step_3_what_gates_a_cast_in_this_engine.count_consistency: Seven casts is consistent with pure cooldown-gated activation on the shared timeline: e.g. a ~12 s window at Q5/W5/E5/R3 with no haste yields Q at 0 and 6 (cd 6), W at 0.6 (cd 12), E at 0.85, 5.85, 10.85 (cd 5) and R once ('R casts exactly once per timed fight', math-foundations table row) = 7 casts. Every one of those seven is admissible on cooldown alone.

step_4_residual_couplings_examined_and_r: P's cooldown is pulled in by 2 s per ability/AA hit (4 s on a Q Sweetspot). This accelerates a timer on a passive auto-attack empowerment; it never makes a cast legal or illegal, and the empowered attack is not a cast in the rotation.

R's +20/30/40% total AD and +50/75/100% self-healing amplify casts that follow it (the corpus's 'Aatrox opens R' and the x2.0 heal factor). That is a stat/state buff read at evaluation time, and an ordering PREFERENCE the optimizer already exploits - not a prerequisite: Q, W and E are all fully castable with R down.
E's passive heal scales with damage dealt (16% + 1.1% per 100 bonus health of post-mitigation damage). A damage-derived output, not a cast input.

Q's +25% per-activation ramp is a fixed positional multiplier applied inside the single Q cast, with a 4 s recast window the engine's 1 s inter-activation spacing can never violate. Nothing to resolve.

reasoning_summary: Aatrox's kit contains no cast prerequisite of any kind: every ability is cost-free, form-free, stack-free and charge-free, admissible on its own cooldown alone. The only two ordering structures in the kit - the Darkin Blade 3-activation chain and the Infernal Chains tether follow-up - are internal to a single cast, which I verified numerically: the engine's recorded Q damage for a full rotation (863.7 post-mitigation vs Ahri) equals the sum of all three activations (1658.34 raw = 442.23 + 552.78 + 663.34, exactly the wiki's 'Maximum Non-Minion Sweetspot Damage' row), and W's recorded 157.5 equals the 'Total Damage' row covering both hits. So the seven ledgers cannot be Q1/Q2/Q3 slots, and no cast among them has anything to declare. An all-empty dependency ledger set is the correct value for Aatrox.
confidence: high on the game facts (Aatrox has zero cast-gating mechanics) and on the cast-granularity finding (verified numerically against the tracked practice corpus). Residual risk, stated openly: the exact schema of a 'dependency ledger' is defined in src/, which this oracle is barred from reading. If that ledger were ever redefined to record intra-cast recast structure (Q's three activations, W's tether) or buff-provenance (R's AD/healing amp feeding later casts), Aatrox would no longer be empty. Under the plain reading - prerequisites a resolver must satisfy before a cast may occur - empty is correct.
caveats: Scenario 'catalyst_roster' is not present in data/practice-corpus/scenarios.json, so the fight's duration, ranks, haste and item set could not be read; the seven-cast count was checked only for plausibility against the shared-timeline scheduling model, not reproduced exactly.

The Q post-mitigation reconstruction lands at 861.9 against the corpus's 863.7 (0.2%). The 1:1 match of the per-activation sum with the wiki's max-damage row is the load-bearing part; the 0.2% is stat-chain rounding and does not affect the structural conclusion.
